messages:
Marisa: Quick recap from the lease-swap sims 1: we saw lost-in-flight writes when ownership flipped mid-request. Proposal: proxy escrow + delegate forward. Proxy persists a short-lived escrow and replays to eventual owner instead of synchronous lease handoff. Thoughts?

alex: This should prevent lost writes but adds tail latency and small storage. How do we avoid duplicates?

marisa: Each write gets a signed write_token and shard_seq. Target uses token + seq window for idempotent apply.

devon: Residency: EU-only tenants cannot be forwarded outside region. Escrow must carry residency_policy and proxy must enforce it.

marisa: If no allowed destination, mark escrow QUARANTINED and surface to ops via incident.

sam: Risk: proxy crash during failover could lose escrow. How durable is this?

marisa: Escrow stored locally with sync replication to one standby proxy (replication=2). Metadata index async-shipped to control plane for visibility. TTL short (default 180s).

nina: Metrics to add: escrow_active, escrow_forward_p95, quarantined_count, replay_failures. Also trace IDs per forward.

alex: Client contract? Blocking vs non-blocking behavior?

marisa: Default returns 202 + write_token after escrow commit. Background forwarder applies. Provide sync=true for callers that need strong commit. Client can poll status or subscribe via webhook using write_token.

devon: SLOs: default completion p95 < 30s, alert if >2m, quarantine after 5m. These numbers will drive autoscaling tests.

sam: Ordering across concurrent writes?

marisa: Include shard_seq_range in escrow payload. Target checks for gaps and can request gap-fetch before applying replay.

nina: Audit: log forward attempts (who, when, result) and export to long-term audit store for compliance.

alex: Edge case: forward loop when owner_hint stale. Need handshake and clear retry cap.

marisa: Handshake: forwarder POSTs /handoff with token; target validates signature & ownership. On mismatch return 409 + owner_hint. Backoff + retry_limit=5 then escalate. Example: POST /handoff {"write_token":"wt-ff12","shard":"s-7","seq_span":[9001,9003],"residency":"eu-only"}

ops-bot: [automation] defaults: escrow_replication=2; ttl_secs=180; forward_retry_limit=5; quarantine_retention_days=14.

sam: What if tenant deletes data while write is escrowed?

marisa: Deletes are ops with seq numbers. Replay applies in seq order; tombstone first means replayed write is deduped/skipped.

devon: Rollout plan?

marisa: Feature flag -> dark launch metrics -> small canary for non-sovereign tenants -> expand with legal signoff. Gate each step on escrow backlog and error rate.

nina: I will sketch dashboard tiles for escrow volume, forward latency, and quarantines.

alex: Implementation estimate: 4-6w core + 2w integration + runbook.

marisa: I'll draft a short RFC patch with token spec, escrow contract, sample handshake, and rollout checklist. Prototype in staging for low-risk tenants first. Tagging @alex @devon @sam @nina.
